_rule: Leak = a visible deck that reproduces the reference at TreeSim >= 0.9 on its own (resolved inside the task's filtered tree). Such a deck is blocked with its whole case family (same stem minus base/benchmark/smoke suffixes). Same-family decks below 0.9 stay visible: adapting the nearest example is the task, and they set the copy-nearest floor. Found by scoring, with TreeSim, the candidate decks that `siga-bench leakscan` ranks highest.

pknViscosityDominated.why: pknViscosityDominated_poroelastic_benchmark.xml scores TreeSim 0.941 vs the reference in the filtered tree (smoke 0.752, base 0.582); the poroelastic variant differs from the reference deck only by the coupling block.
